bank_account_payout_chk.name: bank_account_payout_chk
bank_account_payout_chk.value: (account_number IS NULL) = (ifsc_code IS NULL) AND (account_number IS NOT NULL OR upi_id IS NOT NULL)

gateway_settlement_amounts_nonnegative.name: gateway_settlement_amounts_nonnegative
gateway_settlement_amounts_nonnegative.value: "gateway_settlement"."amount_paise" >= 0 AND "gateway_settlement"."fees_paise" >= 0 AND "gateway_settlement"."tax_paise" >= 0 AND "gateway_settlement"."gross_paise" >= 0 AND "gateway_settlement"."refunds_paise" >= 0 AND coalesce("gateway_settlement"."settlement_fee_paise", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("gateway_settlement"."settlement_tax_paise", 0) >= 0

trustee_term_dates_check.name: trustee_term_dates_check
trustee_term_dates_check.value: ("trustee_term"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "trustee_term"."ends_on" >= "trustee_term"."starts_on") AND ("trustee_term"."ended_on" IS NULL OR "trustee_term"."ended_on" > "trustee_term"."starts_on")

contribution_grant_project_check.name: contribution_grant_project_check
contribution_grant_project_check.value: "contribution"."grant_id" IS NULL OR ("contribution"."programme_id" IS NOT NULL AND "contribution"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

contribution_grant_tranche_check.name: contribution_grant_tranche_check
contribution_grant_tranche_check.value: "contribution"."grant_tranche_id" IS NULL OR "contribution"."grant_id" IS NOT NULL

kalakriti_assignment_edition_scope_uidx.name: kalakriti_assignment_edition_scope_uidx
kalakriti_assignment_edition_scope_uidx.where: "kalakriti_assignment"."center_id" IS NULL AND "kalakriti_assignment"."competition_category_id" IS NULL AND "kalakriti_assignment"."competition_id" IS NULL

kalakriti_assignment_scope_chk.name: kalakriti_assignment_scope_chk
kalakriti_assignment_scope_chk.value:
("kalakriti_assignment"."responsibility"::text IN ('edition_admin', 'volunteer_coordinator', 'volunteer_management_volunteer', 'overall_events_lead', 'liaison_lead', 'food_lead', 'food_member', 'transport_lead', 'logistics_lead', 'logistics_member', 'awards_lead', 'awards_member', 'venue_lead', 'venue_member', 'hospitality_lead', 'hospitality_member', 'media_member', 'fundraising_member', 'escort_volunteer', 'transit_volunteer')
          AND "kalakriti_assignment"."center_id" IS NULL
          AND "kalakriti_assignment"."competition_category_id" IS NULL
          AND "kalakriti_assignment"."competition_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("kalakriti_assignment"."responsibility"::text IN ('liaison', 'center_liaison_lead', 'liaison_volunteer')
          AND "kalakriti_assignment"."center_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "kalakriti_assignment"."competition_category_id" IS NULL
          AND "kalakriti_assignment"."competition_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("kalakriti_assignment"."responsibility"::text = 'competition_category_lead'
          AND "kalakriti_assignment"."center_id" IS NULL
          AND "kalakriti_assignment"."competition_category_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "kalakriti_assignment"."competition_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("kalakriti_assignment"."responsibility"::text IN ('competition_coordinator', 'competition_volunteer')
          AND "kalakriti_assignment"."center_id" IS NULL
          AND "kalakriti_assignment"."competition_category_id" IS NULL
          AND "kalakriti_assignment"."competition_id" IS NOT NULL)

kalakriti_center_scan_stage_finalization.name: kalakriti_center_scan_stage_finalization_chk
kalakriti_center_scan_stage_finalization.value: ("kalakriti_center_scan_stage"."finalized_at" IS NULL AND "kalakriti_center_scan_stage"."finalized_by" IS NULL) OR ("kalakriti_center_scan_stage"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "kalakriti_center_scan_stage"."finalized_by" IS NOT NULL)

kalakriti_competition_entry_music_chk.name: kalakriti_competition_entry_music_chk
kalakriti_competition_entry_music_chk.value:
(
        "kalakriti_competition_entry"."music_object_key" IS NULL
        AND "kalakriti_competition_entry"."music_file_name" IS NULL
        AND "kalakriti_competition_entry"."music_mime_type" IS NULL
        AND "kalakriti_competition_entry"."music_byte_size" IS NULL
        AND "kalakriti_competition_entry"."music_uploaded_at" IS NULL
        AND "kalakriti_competition_entry"."music_uploaded_by" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "kalakriti_competition_entry"."music_object_key" IS NOT NULL
        AND "kalakriti_competition_entry"."music_file_name" IS NOT NULL
        AND "kalakriti_competition_entry"."music_mime_type" IS NOT NULL
        AND "kalakriti_competition_entry"."music_byte_size" IS NOT NULL
        AND "kalakriti_competition_entry"."music_byte_size" > 0
        AND "kalakriti_competition_entry"."music_uploaded_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "kalakriti_competition_entry"."music_uploaded_by" IS NOT NULL
      )

kalakriti_operation_session_chk.name: kalakriti_operation_session_chk

kalakriti_student_age_category_override_.name: kalakriti_student_age_category_override_chk
kalakriti_student_age_category_override_.value:
(
        "kalakriti_student"."age_category_id" = "kalakriti_student"."derived_age_category_id"
        AND "kalakriti_student"."age_category_override_at" IS NULL
        AND "kalakriti_student"."age_category_override_by" IS NULL
        AND "kalakriti_student"."age_category_override_reason" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "kalakriti_student"."age_category_id" <> "kalakriti_student"."derived_age_category_id"
        AND "kalakriti_student"."age_category_override_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "kalakriti_student"."age_category_override_by" IS NOT NULL
        AND length("kalakriti_student"."age_category_override_reason") > 0
      )

kalakriti_student_duplicate_confirmation.name: kalakriti_student_duplicate_confirmation_chk
kalakriti_student_duplicate_confirmation.value:
("kalakriti_student"."duplicate_confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "kalakriti_student"."duplicate_confirmed_by" IS NULL)
        OR ("kalakriti_student"."duplicate_confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "kalakriti_student"."duplicate_confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL)

kalakriti_inventory_item_photo_chk.name: kalakriti_inventory_item_photo_chk
kalakriti_inventory_item_photo_chk.value: ("kalakriti_inventory_item"."photo_key" IS NULL AND "kalakriti_inventory_item"."photo_name" IS NULL AND "kalakriti_inventory_item"."photo_mime_type" IS NULL AND "kalakriti_inventory_item"."photo_size" IS NULL) OR ("kalakriti_inventory_item"."photo_key" IS NOT NULL AND "kalakriti_inventory_item"."photo_name" IS NOT NULL AND "kalakriti_inventory_item"."photo_mime_type" IS NOT NULL AND "kalakriti_inventory_item"."photo_size" IS NOT NULL AND "kalakriti_inventory_item"."photo_size" > 0 AND "kalakriti_inventory_item"."photo_size" <= 5242880)

kalakriti_inventory_tx_type_chk.name: kalakriti_inventory_tx_type_chk
kalakriti_inventory_tx_type_chk.value: ("kalakriti_inventory_transaction"."type" = 'initial_inventory' AND "kalakriti_inventory_transaction"."quantity_before" = 0 AND "kalakriti_inventory_transaction"."quantity" >= 0) OR ("kalakriti_inventory_transaction"."type" IN ('purchase', 'return') AND "kalakriti_inventory_transaction"."quantity" > 0) OR ("kalakriti_inventory_transaction"."type" = 'dispatch' AND "kalakriti_inventory_transaction"."quantity" < 0) OR ("kalakriti_inventory_transaction"."type" = 'adjustment' AND "kalakriti_inventory_transaction"."notes" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("kalakriti_inventory_transaction"."notes")) > 0)

kalakriti_inventory_tx_volunteer_chk.name: kalakriti_inventory_tx_volunteer_chk
kalakriti_inventory_tx_volunteer_chk.value: "kalakriti_inventory_transaction"."type" NOT IN ('dispatch', 'return') OR "kalakriti_inventory_transaction"."volunteer_membership_id" IS NOT NULL

kalakriti_inventory_tx_assignment_chk.name: kalakriti_inventory_tx_assignment_chk
kalakriti_inventory_tx_assignment_chk.value: "kalakriti_inventory_transaction"."responsibility" IS NULL OR ("kalakriti_inventory_transaction"."type" IN ('dispatch', 'return') AND "kalakriti_inventory_transaction"."competition_id" IS NULL)

kalakriti_result_distinct_chk.name: kalakriti_result_distinct_chk
kalakriti_result_distinct_chk.value: "kalakriti_result"."winner_entry_id" IS NULL OR "kalakriti_result"."runner_up_entry_id" IS NULL OR "kalakriti_result"."winner_entry_id" <> "kalakriti_result"."runner_up_entry_id"

kalakriti_result_published_chk.name: kalakriti_result_published_chk
kalakriti_result_published_chk.value: "kalakriti_result"."status" <> 'published' OR ("kalakriti_result"."winner_entry_id" IS NOT NULL AND "kalakriti_result"."runner_up_entry_id" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length("kalakriti_result"."scorecard_ids") > 0)

kalakriti_results_final_chk.name: kalakriti_results_final_chk
kalakriti_results_final_chk.value: "kalakriti_results_state"."finalized_at" IS NULL OR ("kalakriti_results_state"."winner_center_id" IS NOT NULL AND "kalakriti_results_state"."runner_up_center_id" IS NOT NULL AND "kalakriti_results_state"."winner_center_id" <> "kalakriti_results_state"."runner_up_center_id")

audited_figures_status_check.name: audited_figures_status_check
audited_figures_status_check.value: ("audited_figures"."status" = 'matched' AND "audited_figures"."ca_name" IS NOT NULL AND "audited_figures"."signed_on" IS NOT NULL AND "audited_figures"."skip_reason" IS NULL) OR ("audited_figures"."status" = 'skipped' AND "audited_figures"."skip_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "audited_figures"."posting_id" IS NULL)

audited_figures_reversal_check.name: audited_figures_reversal_check
audited_figures_reversal_check.value: "audited_figures"."reversal_posting_id" IS NULL OR "audited_figures"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL

reimbursement_charged_to_chk.name: reimbursement_charged_to_chk
reimbursement_charged_to_chk.value: ("reimbursement"."charged_to" = 'event' AND "reimbursement"."event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reimbursement"."charged_programme_id" IS NULL AND "reimbursement"."charged_project_id" IS NULL) OR ("reimbursement"."charged_to" = 'programme' AND "reimbursement"."event_id" IS NULL AND "reimbursement"."charged_programme_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("reimbursement"."charged_to" = 'organisation' AND "reimbursement"."event_id" IS NULL AND "reimbursement"."charged_programme_id" IS NULL AND "reimbursement"."charged_project_id" IS NULL)

reimbursement_rejection_reason_chk.name: reimbursement_rejection_reason_chk
reimbursement_rejection_reason_chk.value: ((status = 'rejected'::reimbursement_status) AND (rejection_reason IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status <> 'rejected'::reimbursement_status) AND (rejection_reason IS NULL))

reimbursement_void_chk.name: reimbursement_void_chk
reimbursement_void_chk.value: (voided_at IS NULL AND void_reason IS NULL) OR (voided_at IS NOT NULL AND void_reason IS NOT NULL)

statement_allocation_live_reimbursement_.name: statement_allocation_live_reimbursement_uidx
statement_allocation_live_reimbursement_.where: "statement_allocation"."reimbursement_id" is not null and "statement_allocation"."released_at" is null

statement_allocation_live_vpt_uidx.name: statement_allocation_live_vpt_uidx
statement_allocation_live_vpt_uidx.where: "statement_allocation"."vendor_payment_transaction_id" is not null and "statement_allocation"."released_at" is null

statement_allocation_target.name: statement_allocation_target
statement_allocation_target.value:
("statement_allocation"."kind"::text = 'reimbursement') = ("statement_allocation"."reimbursement_id" is not null)
        and ("statement_allocation"."kind"::text = 'vendor_payment_transaction') = ("statement_allocation"."vendor_payment_transaction_id" is not null)

statement_allocation_released.name: statement_allocation_released
statement_allocation_released.value: "statement_allocation"."released_by" is null or "statement_allocation"."released_at" is not null

statement_line_match_consistent.name: statement_line_match_consistent
statement_line_match_consistent.value:
("statement_line"."match_status"::text = 'matched') = ("statement_line"."match_kind" is not null)
        and (coalesce("statement_line"."match_kind"::text, '') = 'settlement') = ("statement_line"."matched_settlement_id" is not null)
        and (coalesce("statement_line"."match_kind"::text, '') = 'contribution') = ("statement_line"."matched_contribution_id" is not null)
        and ("statement_line"."match_status"::text = 'ignored') = ("statement_line"."ignored_reason" is not null)

team_event_active_root_startTime_id_idx.name: team_event_active_root_startTime_id_idx
team_event_active_root_startTime_id_idx.where: cancelled_at IS NULL AND series_id IS NULL

team_event_end_after_start_chk.name: team_event_end_after_start_chk
team_event_end_after_start_chk.value: end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= start_time

vendor_payment_charged_to_chk.name: vendor_payment_charged_to_chk
vendor_payment_charged_to_chk.value: ("vendor_payment"."charged_to" = 'event' AND "vendor_payment"."event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "vendor_payment"."charged_programme_id" IS NULL AND "vendor_payment"."charged_project_id" IS NULL) OR ("vendor_payment"."charged_to" = 'programme' AND "vendor_payment"."event_id" IS NULL AND "vendor_payment"."charged_programme_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("vendor_payment"."charged_to" = 'organisation' AND "vendor_payment"."event_id" IS NULL AND "vendor_payment"."charged_programme_id" IS NULL AND "vendor_payment"."charged_project_id" IS NULL)

vendor_payment_rejection_reason_chk.name: vendor_payment_rejection_reason_chk
vendor_payment_rejection_reason_chk.value: ((status = 'rejected'::vendor_payment_status) AND (rejection_reason IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status <> 'rejected'::vendor_payment_status) AND (rejection_reason IS NULL))

vendor_payment_void_chk.name: vendor_payment_void_chk
vendor_payment_void_chk.value: (voided_at IS NULL AND void_reason IS NULL) OR (voided_at IS NOT NULL AND void_reason IS NOT NULL)

vpt_rejection_reason_chk.name: vpt_rejection_reason_chk
vpt_rejection_reason_chk.value: ((status = 'rejected'::vendor_payment_transaction_status) AND (rejection_reason IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status <> 'rejected'::vendor_payment_transaction_status) AND (rejection_reason IS NULL))

vpt_void_chk.name: vpt_void_chk
vpt_void_chk.value: (voided_at IS NULL AND void_reason IS NULL) OR (voided_at IS NOT NULL AND void_reason IS NOT NULL)

donation_filing_submitted_fields.name: donation_filing_submitted_fields
donation_filing_submitted_fields.value: ("private"."donation_filing"."status" = 'submitted') = ("private"."donation_filing"."filed_on" IS NOT NULL AND "private"."donation_filing"."acknowledgement_number" IS NOT NULL AND "private"."donation_filing"."transaction_id" IS NOT NULL)
